    <h2 id="directions">Getting here</h2>
    <div class="msm-card">
      <span class="msm-kicker"><i class="fa-solid fa-train" aria-hidden="true"></i>&nbsp; By train</span>
      <p>From Berlin Hauptbahnhof take the S5 or S7 to Berlin-Lichtenberg, then the RB26 towards Kostrzyn (PL) to Müncheberg station. From there take bus 939 towards Müncheberg-Stadt to the stop “Müncheberg, ZALF” (one stop).</p>
    </div>
    <div class="msm-card" style="margin-top:16px">
      <span class="msm-kicker"><i class="fa-solid fa-car" aria-hidden="true"></i>&nbsp; By car</span>
      <p>From Berlin take federal road B1 towards Frankfurt (Oder), exit at Müncheberg and continue about 3 km towards Eberswalde.</p>
    </div>
    <p class="msm-note">Full directions: <a href="https://www.zalf.de/en/ueber_uns/kontakt_anfahrt/Pages/default.aspx">ZALF contact &amp; location</a>.</p>

</div>
